widget.text: Photorealistic photograph of an old movie theater with faded red seats, peeling walls, and a torn screen.
A rally car speeding across vast desert dunes, throwing a dramatic trail of sand behind it.
Photorealistic editorial photograph of a woman barista making a latte in a modern, minimalist café on a sunny tropical morning.

A lone astronaut crossing a dark, frozen lake beneath enormous rings stretching across an alien sky. Fine cracks visible under the translucent ice, distant mountains, soft blue twilight, cinematic scale, photorealistic detail.
